objects.definition:
typedef enum {
  AUSTRALIA_AQI,
  CANADA_AQHI,
  CHINA_AQI,
  EUROPEAN_UNION_CAQI,
  HONG_KONG_AQHI,
  INDIA_AQI,
  SINGAPORE_PSI,
  SOUTH_KOREA_CAI,
  UNITED_KINGDOM_DAQI,
  UNITED_STATES_AQI,
  NUM_AQI_SCALES
} aqi_scale_t;
objects.description: Enumeration of supported Air Quality Index scales. Values select the regional/national AQI computation and associated descriptors. NUM_AQI_SCALES marks the count sentinel.
Enumeration describing whether a scale’s textual categories refer to overall air quality or to air pollution levels.

functions.name: australia_aqi
functions.signature: int australia_aqi(float co_8h, float no2_1h, float o3_1h, float o3_4h, float so2_1h, float pm10_24h, float pm2_5_24h);
functions.description: Computes the Australia AQI, returning the AQI rounded to the nearest integer. Each parameter is a pollutant concentration in μg/m^3 already averaged over the specified period (suffix indicates averaging window). Intended for callers that have pre-averaged concentrations for the required windows.
requirements: All inputs are pollutant concentrations in μg/m^3.
Each parameter must represent the average over its indicated period (e.g., co_8h is an 8-hour moving average, o3_4h is a 4-hour average).
No mechanism is provided for marking missing data via these scalar parameters; callers should supply concrete float values.
Return value is the AQI rounded to the nearest integer; specific range and capping behavior are not documented.

functions.name: canada_aqhi
functions.signature: int canada_aqhi(float no2_3h, float o3_3h, float pm2_5_3h);
functions.description: Computes the Canada AQHI (Air Quality Health Index), returning the index rounded to the nearest integer, from 3-hour averaged concentrations in μg/m^3.
requirements: Inputs are μg/m^3 concentrations averaged over 3 hours as indicated by the _3h suffix.
No explicit mechanism to indicate missing data for this scalar API.
Return value is rounded to the nearest integer; exact range/capping not documented here.

functions.name: china_aqi
functions.signature: int china_aqi(float co_1h, float co_24h, float no2_1h, float no2_24h, float o3_1h, float o3_8h, float so2_1h, float so2_24h, float pm10_24h, float pm2_5_24h);
functions.description: Computes the China AQI, returning the AQI rounded to the nearest integer, using provided pollutant concentrations in μg/m^3 averaged over the indicated windows.
requirements: All inputs are μg/m^3 concentrations averaged over the specified period (e.g., co_1h is 1-hour average, co_24h is 24-hour average, o3_8h is 8-hour average).
Scalar API provides no NULL/missing indicator; supply concrete values.
Return value is rounded; range/capping behavior not documented here.

functions.name: european_union_caqi

functions.description: Computes the European Union CAQI, returning the index rounded to the nearest integer, from 1-hour averaged μg/m^3 concentrations.
requirements: Inputs are μg/m^3, each representing a 1-hour average as indicated.
No missing-data mechanism for the scalar API; provide concrete values.
Return value is rounded; exact range/capping not documented here.

Return value is rounded; precise range/capping not documented.

functions.name: calc_australia_aqi
functions.signature: int calc_australia_aqi(const float co[24], const float nh3[24], const float no[24], const float no2[24], const float o3[24], const float pb[24], const float so2[24], const float pm10[24], const float pm2_5[24]);
functions.description: Computes Australia AQI from hourly concentration samples, returning the AQI rounded to the nearest integer. Arrays contain hourly μg/m^3 samples ordered from least recent (index 0) to most recent (index 23). The function performs required time averaging internally.
requirements: Each non-NULL pollutant pointer must reference an array of at least 24 float values.
Arrays must be ordered from least recent (index 0) to most recent (index 23).
Pass NULL (or an array of 0s) to indicate a pollutant concentration is not available.
Inputs are μg/m^3 concentrations.
Return value is rounded to nearest integer.
Averaging windows are applied internally according to the Australia AQI definition.

functions.description: Computes Canada AQHI from hourly μg/m^3 samples, returning the index rounded to the nearest integer. Performs the necessary 3-hour averaging internally where applicable.
requirements: Each non-NULL pollutant pointer must reference an array of at least 24 floats.
Arrays must be ordered from least recent (0) to most recent (23).
Pass NULL (or an array of 0s) to indicate missing pollutant data.
Inputs are μg/m^3 concentrations.
Return value is rounded to nearest integer.

Arrays must be ordered from least recent (0) to most recent (23).

Inputs are μg/m^3 concentrations.

functions.description: Computes UK DAQI from hourly μg/m^3 samples, returning the index rounded to the nearest integer. The UK DAQI uniquely requires a 15-minute SO2 average; this API instead uses the most recent hourly concentration for SO2 as a substitute per the library note.
requirements: Each non-NULL pollutant pointer must reference an array of at least 24 floats.
Arrays must be ordered from least recent (0) to most recent (23).
Pass NULL (or an array of 0s) to indicate missing pollutant data.
Inputs are μg/m^3 concentrations.
Return value is rounded to nearest integer.
For SO2, the most recent hourly concentration (index 23) will be used in place of the required 15-minute average as noted.

functions.name: calc_aqi
functions.signature: int calc_aqi(aqi_scale_t scale, const float co[24], const float nh3[24], const float no[24], const float no2[24], const float o3[24], const float pb[24], const float so2[24], const float pm10[24], const float pm2_5[24]);
functions.description: Generic entry point to compute an AQI for a given scale from hourly μg/m^3 samples, returning the index rounded to the nearest integer. Performs required averaging internally according to the chosen scale.
requirements: scale must be one of the aqi_scale_t enum values (e.g., AUSTRALIA_AQI, UNITED_STATES_AQI, etc.).
Each non-NULL pollutant pointer must reference an array of at least 24 floats.
Arrays must be ordered from least recent (index 0) to most recent (index 23).
Pass NULL (or an array of 0s) for pollutants without available data.
Inputs are μg/m^3 concentrations.
Return value is rounded to nearest integer.
For the UK DAQI scale, the most recent hourly SO2 sample will be used instead of a 15-minute average as noted in the header.

functions.name: aqi_scale_max
functions.signature: int aqi_scale_max(aqi_scale_t scale);
functions.description: Returns the maximum index value for the specified AQI scale (e.g., UNITED_STATES_AQI_MAX = 500). Above the maximum, indices are typically represented as ">max" or "max+".
requirements: scale must be a valid aqi_scale_t value.
Return value is the defined maximum for the scale; behavior for invalid scale values is not documented.

requirements: Input is an integer AQI value; expected to be in the scale’s defined range (AUSTRALIA_AQI_MAX = 200).

Returned pointer refers to an internal or external descriptor string.

functions.name: aqi_desc
functions.signature: const char *aqi_desc(aqi_scale_t scale, int val);
functions.description: Given an AQI scale and an index value, returns a pointer to the corresponding descriptor/category string for that scale.
requirements: scale must be a valid aqi_scale_t value.
val should be an integer index appropriate to the chosen scale; behavior for out-of-range values is not documented.
Returned pointer refers to a descriptor string.

functions.name: aqi_desc_type
functions.signature: aqi_desc_type_t aqi_desc_type(aqi_scale_t scale);
functions.description: Returns whether a scale’s descriptors describe air quality or air pollution (AIR_QUALITY_DESC or AIR_POLLUTION_DESC).
requirements: scale must be a valid aqi_scale_t value.
Return is one of AIR_QUALITY_DESC or AIR_POLLUTION_DESC as defined for each scale.
Behavior for invalid scale values is not documented.
